description: Synthetic visual inspection timeline demonstrating progressive bearing failure.

findings.visual_evidence: Camera frame shows intact epoxy enamel coating across bearing housing; labyrinth shaft seal is dry with zero fluid egress; flexible coupling aligned with zero particulate debris.
findings.possible_implication: Nominal baseline machine appearance; no visual indicators of mechanical or thermal distress.

stage_1_normal.summary: Visual inspection of PUMP_001 confirms normal exterior condition.

findings.visual_evidence: Dark, viscous fluid weeping and droplet trails radiating from the drive-end labyrinth seal interface onto the pump pedestal baseplate.
findings.possible_implication: Active lubricant seal weeping indicating grease depletion and loss of hydrodynamic lubrication film in the drive-end bearing cavity.

findings.visual_evidence: Frayed elastomeric seal lip with dark grit and slurry particulate caking around the shaft entry collar.
findings.possible_implication: Environmental seal barrier compromised; high risk of abrasive particulate ingress into the bearing raceway accelerating 3-body abrasive wear.

stage_2_incipient.summary: Visual inspection of PUMP_001 identified 2 finding(s): DEFECT_OIL_LEAK, DEFECT_SEAL_CONTAMINATION with maximum severity MEDIUM.

findings.visual_evidence: Severe dark brown and blackened thermal discoloration centered on the cast-iron drive-end bearing housing with visible paint blistering and peeling.
findings.possible_implication: Prolonged extreme internal heat generation (>90°C surface temperature) from severe metal-to-metal raceway spalling and imminent bearing seizure.

findings.visual_evidence: Substantial dark grease puddle pooling beneath drive-end bearing housing with continuous viscous run-off.
findings.possible_implication: Complete failure of labyrinth grease retention; bearing cavity is severely starved of lubricant.

stage_3_severe.summary: Visual inspection of PUMP_001 identified 2 finding(s): DEFECT_THERMAL_DISCOLOR, DEFECT_OIL_LEAK with maximum severity CRITICAL.
